name: Cash flow projections and evidence
description: Verify horizons, charts, concentration, monthly detail, debt pressure, and data controls.

planSteps.description: The page shows cash horizons, first negative month, worst month, consecutive negative period, cash trend, income-versus-expense chart, and debt-service pressure
Activate Aylık görünüm, Yoğunlaşma, and Veri kontrolleri tabs one by one
Each tab or anchored section opens without a broken route and exposes the corresponding monthly, concentration, or data-control content
Open one month from the monthly cash-flow list
The month detail shows opening balance, income, expense, closing balance, grouped lines, and a source workbook or source-sheet link
Follow the source evidence link and then return
The source page opens successfully and cash-flow navigation remains available after returning
